# Liquid Glass Studio renderer

Source: https://github.com/iyinchao/liquid-glass-studio
Pinned revision: `f7b28c36305a862f5cffed3ddd51511cf1204f56`
Copyright (c) 2024 Charles Yin. MIT; see LICENSE.

Only the WebGL2 renderer and GLSL shaders are included. No React UI, photographs, videos, or Apple artwork is bundled. `source/` retains the upstream source. `renderer.js` is GLUtils.ts with TypeScript syntax removed; `shaders.js` embeds the five required shaders with local includes expanded. Qrer's integration lives outside this directory.
